title: IBM 8-bar logo

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Protect a symbol’s separation from nearby material so viewers can recognize it and correctly read the partner relationship.
strategic_value: Measured clear space can preserve the IBM mark’s integrity while keeping it in a supporting role.
demonstration: The page pairs logo rationale and two clear-space cases with a large IBM mark surrounded by X-height boxes and a registration note.
practical_value: Distinguish the ordinary visual-element clearance from the larger separation required from the partner’s own logo.

content_islands.name: Rationale and clear-space text
content_islands.spec: Place explanatory copy at left, separating Visual elements from Your logo.

content_islands.name: Measurement diagram
content_islands.spec: Center the IBM mark in the larger right field and show X boxes around it, defining X by the I height.

content_islands.name: Registration note
content_islands.spec: Keep the worldwide registration-mark recommendation beside the diagram.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source calls the mark a symbol of expertise, values, people and offerings, and explains the partner separation as maintaining IBM’s supportive position.
reference_purposes.Application: The diagram defines X as the height of the I and applies it to surrounding clear space.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Typical visual elements require at least 1X separation; the partner logo should be no closer than 3X. The registration mark is recommended worldwide, not described as legally required everywhere.

ingredient.name: 8-bar clear space
ingredient.role: Keep the logo recognizable and separate from the partner identity.
ingredient.application: Reserve at least one logo-height X around ordinary visual elements and at least 3X from the partner logo.
ingredient.scope: Version1.2 strategic-partner guide. X equals the height of the I in IBM; the partner-logo case differs from ordinary images, copy and CTAs.
